job
工作
What would matter most when choosing your next job?
I would choose a job where I could learn from experienced people. A clear workload would matter more than an impressive title.
我會選能向有經驗的人學習的工作。比起漂亮的職稱，我更在意工作量是否清楚。
career
職涯
How could you explore a different career without leaving your current work immediately?
I could explore another career through a short course and informational interviews. That would help me test my interest before making a major change.
我可以先上短期課程，也找業內人士聊聊。換職涯前，先確認自己是否真的有興趣。
office
辦公室
What would make an office better for focused work?
An office needs places for both conversation and concentration. I would separate quiet desks from areas used for frequent calls.
辦公室需要討論的地方，也需要專心工作的地方。我會把安靜座位和常講電話的區域分開。
colleague
同事
A new colleague seems hesitant to ask questions. How would you help?
I would offer to show my colleague one routine task. A friendly first conversation might make it easier to ask for help later.
我會主動帶新同事做一件日常工作。先友善地聊過，之後他可能就比較敢求助。
manager
經理
How would you tell your manager that your workload is too heavy?
I would show my manager my current tasks and deadlines. Then we could decide together which work should come first.
我會把目前的工作和期限列給經理看。再一起決定，哪些事情應該優先處理。
employee
員工
What support should a new employee receive during the first week?
A new employee should receive clear instructions and a named contact for questions. A manageable first task would help build confidence.
新員工需要清楚的說明，也要知道有問題能找誰。先安排做得到的任務，能建立信心。
interview
面試
How would you prepare a useful example for a job interview?
For an interview, I would prepare one example of solving a problem. I would explain my role and the result honestly.
準備面試時，我會選一個解決問題的例子。清楚、誠實地說明自己的角色和結果。
application
申請
What would you check before sending a job application?
I would check that my application addressed the actual role. Then I would proofread the contact details and required attachments.
送出求職申請前，我會確認內容符合職缺。再檢查聯絡資料和必須附上的文件。
qualification
資格
Would you apply for a role if you lacked one listed qualification?
I might apply if the missing qualification was not essential. I would explain my relevant experience without pretending to have credentials I lacked.
如果缺少的資格不是必要條件，我還是可能申請。我會說明相關經驗，不假裝擁有沒有的證照。
skill
技能
Which skill could make teamwork easier for you?
Listening carefully is a skill I want to strengthen. It would help me understand a problem before offering a solution.
我想加強仔細聆聽的技能。先了解問題，再提出辦法，合作起來會更順利。
occupation
職業
What would you ask someone about an occupation you are considering?
I would ask what a normal day in that occupation looks like. The routine work could matter more than its most exciting moments.
我會問這個職業平常一天怎麼過。比起最精彩的時刻，日常工作可能更值得了解。
task
任務
How would you begin a task with unclear instructions?
I would ask what a successful result should look like before starting the task. A small example could prevent a lot of rework.
開始任務前，我會先問清楚怎樣才算做好。一個小例子，就可能省下很多重做的時間。
deadline
期限
You realize you cannot meet a deadline. What would you do?
I would explain the problem before the deadline arrived. I would suggest a revised date and identify anything I could deliver sooner.
我會在期限到之前說明狀況。提出新的完成日期，也說清楚哪些部分能先交。
project
專案
What would you clarify before joining a new project?
I would clarify the project's goal and my responsibilities. Knowing who makes final decisions would also help the team avoid confusion.
加入專案前，我會確認目標和自己的責任。也要知道最後由誰決定，避免大家各做各的。
meeting
會議
How could you make a regular meeting shorter and more useful?
I would share the agenda before the meeting. We could focus on decisions rather than read information everyone already had.
我會在會議前先發議程。開會時專心做決定，不必重念大家已經看過的資料。
schedule
安排
How would you schedule demanding work during a busy week?
I would schedule demanding work when I usually have the most energy. I would leave smaller gaps for routine messages.
我會把需要動腦的工作安排在精神最好的時段。零碎的空檔則留給例行訊息。
team
團隊
What should a team do when two members disagree about a plan?
The team should agree on the problem before comparing solutions. A small trial could provide better evidence than a long argument.
團隊應該先確認要解決什麼問題，再比較辦法。做個小測試，可能比爭論半天更有用。
salary
薪水
What would you consider besides salary when comparing job offers?
Besides salary, I would compare working hours and travel time. A higher income might not compensate for losing most of my evenings.
除了薪水，我也會比較工時和通勤時間。收入再高，也未必值得犧牲大部分的晚上。
promote
推廣
How would you promote a small business without a large advertising budget?
I would promote the business by sharing useful demonstrations of its products. Satisfied customers could also help through honest recommendations.
我會分享實用的產品示範來推廣小店。滿意的客人，也能透過真實推薦幫忙。
feedback
回饋
What kind of feedback helps you improve your work?
Specific feedback helps me most because I know what to change. One clear example is more useful than a general judgment.
具體的回饋最能幫助我，因為我知道該改哪裡。一個清楚的例子，比籠統評價更有用。
performance
表現
How would you assess your performance after a difficult month at work?
I would compare my performance with realistic goals, not just how busy I felt. I would also note what slowed me down.
我會用合理的目標檢查表現，不只看自己忙不忙。也記下哪些事情拖慢了進度。
professional
專業
How can you remain professional during a tense conversation at work?
I can remain professional by discussing the specific problem rather than blaming someone. If necessary, I would ask for a short break.
我會針對具體問題討論，不責怪個人，保持專業。必要時，先提出暫停一下再談。
flexible
彈性
What would flexible working hours help you manage?
Flexible hours would help me avoid the busiest commute. I would still agree on times when colleagues could reliably reach me.
彈性工時能讓我避開通勤尖峰。我仍會和同事約好，哪些時段一定聯絡得到我。
efficient
有效率
What simple change could make an everyday work process more efficient?
A shared checklist would make our handover more efficient. People would spend less time asking whether essential steps had been completed.
共用檢查表，能讓交接更有效率。大家就不用一直問，必要的步驟到底做完沒有。
